planner_json.title: Install, load and invoke OpenCode on both tracks through its namespaced commands
depends_on: GAW-1 (the adapter contract, declarations, stance table, probe runner and real-cli test harness this adapter builds on)
GAW-2 (the stop_at option its must-ask entry passes to the runtime)

write_prohibited: plugins/pixel-perfect/** - GAW-10 owns the plugin fix
Any keyed step in `.github/workflows/harness-eval.yml` except OpenCode's, which gains one line
Any file not listed in WRITE-ALLOWED

seed/pinned-opencode.description: opencode-ai at the pinned version installed by npm under a temp prefix, with a temp HOME and an allowlisted env, and a fresh invocation directory

specification.objective: OpenCode installs and runs through its namespaced commands on both tracks, and each graded run proves from its own session whether its arguments reached the command.
specification.success_state: After a real-copy install, the CLI's own config lists 11 of 11 commands. Every graded argv holds its command with no `--auto`. A placeholder-key run's export shows the arguments in the user message, and a run they did not reach reads a named could-not-run. The registry serves this adapter, and the keyed step runs the denied-write probe on pinned.

requirements.description: GIVEN the pinned OpenCode CLI in a temp HOME and a fresh invocation directory WHEN the adapter's keyless load runs, then runs again with the commands directory removed THEN `opencode debug config` lists 11 of 11 names including `pixel-perfect/status`, `observed_cli_version` reads `1.18.34` with `identity_decision.ok` true, and the removed directory reads `could-not-run` on command_list
requirements.verification_service: real opencode-ai at the pinned version in a temp HOME
requirements.positive_example: Fresh invocation directory: 11 stems under .opencode/commands/pixel-perfect, debug config lists the same 11 keys, and the identity digest equals the checkout digest.
requirements.red: On base the registry answers opencode-adapter-not-implemented, no load runs, and the command assertion fails.

scenario.verification_service: real opencode-ai at the pinned version in a temp HOME

would_fail_if: the install uses a symlink, so the CLI registers 0 commands
the list reads the flat path
the commands directory is absent and the check reads fail instead of could-not-run

build_proof.range: anything that proves OpenCode itself sees the checkout's commands in this directory
examples: the CLI's own command map after the copy

steps: run the adapter's keyless load into a fresh directory
run it again with the commands directory removed

must_observe: 11 of 11 names, including `pixel-perfect/status`, in `opencode debug config`'s command map
the removed directory reads `could-not-run` on command_list
must_not_observe: a command_list `fail` on the removed directory
an empty command map with 0 keys on the first run

requirements.description: GIVEN the adapter's invocation table at the pinned CLI, with an empty env and a placeholder key the API rejects WHEN each graded entry runs keyless and its argv is read, then the status entry runs with the placeholder key under a plugin module returning `{}`, then under one returning nothing, then with its message dropped, and `opencode debug config` reads the permission THEN each argv holds its command and `--format` `json` with no `--auto`, the first export's user message holds `Invocation input: --platform web-desktop`, the other two read `opencode-no-user-message` and `opencode-args-channel-failed`, and `permission` equals the adapter's rules
requirements.verification_service: real opencode run, export and debug config at the pinned version, with an empty env and a placeholder key the API rejects
requirements.positive_example: In a directory whose plugin module returns {}, the status entry's run leaves a session whose user message reads Invocation input: --platform web-desktop followed by the declaration, and no refusal is recorded. A plugin module returning nothing reads opencode-no-user-message. The same run with its message dropped reads opencode-args-channel-failed.
requirements.red: On base no opencode table exists, so reading its argv from a persisted capture fails.

scenario.verification_service: real opencode run, export and debug config at the pinned version, with an empty env and a placeholder key the API rejects

would_fail_if: the -- is omitted, so the CLI reads --platform as its own flag
the export check is removed, so a run whose arguments never arrived is graded
the refusal persists no capture, so the check cites no evidence
the bare command name is used, so the plugin command is absent

build_proof.range: anything that proves a keyed OpenCode step cannot approve itself, that fixture arguments and the status declaration reach the command, and that the run says so when they do not
examples: a check of the exported session's user message

steps: run each graded entry with every credential removed and read the persisted captures' argv
run the status entry with the placeholder key in a directory whose plugin module returns {}, and read session-export.json
run it again in a directory whose plugin module returns nothing
run it again with the message dropped, and run opencode debug config in a keyless child with the adapter's OPENCODE_PERMISSION

must_observe: each argv holds `--command` `pixel-perfect/<name>` and `--format` `json`, status and verify hold `--` `--platform` `web-desktop`, and first-question holds no message
the export's user message holds `Invocation input: --platform web-desktop`, and no refusal is recorded
the module returning nothing reads reason `opencode-no-user-message`, and the dropped message reads reason `opencode-args-channel-failed`, each with at least 1 evidence path
debug config's `permission` equals the adapter's rules
must_not_observe: a `pass` on a case whose arguments never reached the command
an empty argv in any capture
